recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
flutter_version=$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter\:\s*([0-9.]+)$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)
git clone -b $flutter_version https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle

git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.27.1
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}

export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
bash ./scripts/isar/fdroid_build_isar.sh arm64
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

flutter/bin/flutter pub get

flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"

recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION=$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter\:\s*([0-9.]+)$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)
RUST_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.27.1
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_VERSION --target aarch64-linux-android
cp .isar-cargo.lock .isar/Cargo.lock
source $HOME/.cargo/env
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
bash ./scripts/isar/fdroid_build_isar.sh arm64
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION=$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter\:\s*([0-9.]+)$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)
RUST_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.27.1
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_VERSION --target aarch64-linux-android
cp .isar-cargo.lock .isar/Cargo.lock
source $HOME/.cargo/env
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
bash ./scripts/isar/fdroid_build_isar.sh arm64
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION=$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter\:\s*([0-9.]+)$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)
RUST_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.27.1
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}

bash ./scripts/isar/fdroid_build_isar.sh arm64
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"

recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.release/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
FLUTTER_VERSION=$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter\:\s*([0-9.]+)$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)
RUST_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/channel = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
git clone https://github.com/rust-lang/rustup.git -b 1.27.1
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/opt/sdk/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_VERSION --target aarch64-linux-android
cp .isar-cargo.lock .isar/Cargo.lock
source $HOME/.cargo/env
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
bash ./scripts/isar/fdroid_build_isar.sh arm64
flutter/bin/dart run build_runner build
flutter/bin/flutter gen-l10n
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi --target-platform="android-arm64"
mv build/app/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
